findings.reason: The original standalone screenshot contains only the long weak formulation and characteristic definition. A concrete flow schematic materially clarifies the distinction between increasing-size transport, nonlocal daughter production, parent removal, and the absorbing upper boundary; the separate measure arrow avoids conflating births with a characteristic trajectory.
findings.action: Added one explanatory TikZ schematic and precise supporting prose in final Remarks, preserving the Definition.

correction: Appended a schematic with the stopped increasing-size characteristic, absorbing X boundary, daughter measure K_y(dx) on [0,y], parent-removal rate mu(y)+gamma(y), and no incoming boundary source at zero. The caption explicitly permits daughters at zero and inserts no gamma factor into K_y.

diagram_math_checks.data: Parent starts at y<X; growth arrow points toward X.
diagram_math_checks.check: Definition line 32 assumes g>=g_min>0 and line 40 defines chi_y as the extended IVP stopped at min(T,tau_y). Thus chi_y prime=g(chi_y)>0 on its characteristic interval. The caption qualifies exit by reaching X within the horizon and does not assert that every parent exits by T.

diagram_math_checks.data: Absorbing X and zero boundary annotation.
diagram_math_checks.check: Definition line 38 identifies absorbing outflow at X through phi(t,X)=0 and no incoming source at zero. The diagram has no incoming arrow at zero. The added prose distinguishes absence of boundary inflow from permitted K_y mass at zero.

diagram_math_checks.data: Parent y to daughter sizes x in [0,y], labeled K_y(dx).
diagram_math_checks.check: Definition line 32 states K_y is a finite nonnegative Borel measure supported on [0,y]. The positive term in line 36 integrates K_y(dx) against nu_t(dy), without an additional gamma(y) factor. The schematic and caption reproduce precisely that interface and impose no density, finite daughter list, or conservation property.

diagram_math_checks.data: Parent y to parent removal, labeled mu(y)+gamma(y).
diagram_math_checks.check: Definition line 32 identifies ordinary mortality and removal of dividing parents, and line 36 has loss -(mu+gamma)phi. The removal arrow records the combined instantaneous loss rate, separately from daughter production.
The existing Definition and complete weak formulation are unchanged. No argument or defining condition relies on the schematic; the final caption explicitly states this.
